concepts.def: Lowers activation energy, not delta H
Curve flattens as reactants run out
Reactions that can go both ways

walkthroughs.body_html:
Reactants on the left, products on the right.

Peak height above reactants = activation energy.

Net difference = enthalpy change.

Catalyst lowers Ea by providing an alternative pathway.

It does not change delta H.

Equilibrium position is unchanged.

Increase reactant concentration -> shifts towards products.

Increase temperature -> shifts in endothermic direction.

Increase pressure -> shifts towards fewer gas moles.
